title: Temporary pickup move: Pick up West Room reservations at the North Desk (12–16 May) — what to bring and what doesn't change
description: A short clear notice for borrowers who have an existing tool reservation for pickup at the West Room between 12 and 16 May. The piece will state the temporary change of pickup location to the North Desk in the same building, remind borrowers that the printed pickup window still applies, list what to bring (confirmation and library card), state that returns remain at the usual return counter, and tell borrowers with later pickup dates to use the location on their confirmation. It will also include a brief caveat about staff lookup reliability (desk drill found 9 of 10 test records on first lookup) and note that no decision has been made about keeping the North Desk for summer.
audience: Borrowers who already reserved a tool for pickup at the West Room between 12 and 16 May
rationale: The primary reader need is immediate: know where and when to collect an already-reserved tool and what to bring. The source limits the scope to existing reservations for that five-day window and specifies what remains unchanged, so the notice must be concise, action-oriented, and bounded to those facts. Including the lookup drill result and the management caveat addresses likely borrower concerns (will staff find my reservation? is this permanent?) without overstating outcomes.
evidence: Source states: "existing West Room reservations will be collected at the North Desk in the same building"; "The pickup window printed on each confirmation still applies. Bring the confirmation and a library card."; "Borrowers with a later pickup date should use the location on their confirmation."; "The change applies to pickups only. Returns remain at the usual return counter."; also: "A few staff suggested keeping the North Desk for the summer. Management has made no decision about summer." and "In a desk drill, staff located nine of ten test records on the first lookup. These were test records and no borrowers took part."

title: FAQ for borrowers about the 12–16 May North Desk pickup change
description: A concise FAQ answering anticipated questions: Why is pickup moved? Which reservations are affected? Exact dates and times (refer to printed pickup windows), what to bring, what to do if you miss your window, where to return items, and whether the change is permanent. Include a clear statement that later pickups should follow the location on the confirmation and a short note on staff lookup reliability based on the drill.
audience: Borrowers with reservations around the affected dates and prospective visitors who might be confused by the temporary change
rationale: Borrowers will have predictable follow-up questions after seeing a short notice; an FAQ reduces incoming queries to staff and prevents misdirected trips. The source supports the factual Q&A content and signals uncertainty (no decision on summer) that should be surfaced to readers.
evidence: Source details applicable dates and location change: "between 12 and 16 May" and "collected at the North Desk"; instructions to bring confirmation and library card; "Borrowers with a later pickup date should use the location on their confirmation."; returns unaffected; summer decision not made; and desk drill finding (9 of 10) to contextualize lookup reliability.

title: Staff memo: desk-drill results and recommendation checklist for North Desk pickups

rationale: Staff need clear operational instructions and the drill results to prepare for the temporary change and to inform a management decision about summer location. The source provides the drill outcome and highlights that management has not decided about summer, making a staff memo appropriate.
evidence: "In a desk drill, staff located nine of ten test records on the first lookup. These were test records and no borrowers took part."; "A few staff suggested keeping the North Desk for the summer. title: Point-of-contact signage and North Desk staff script for 12–16 May pickups
description: Design copy for a simple poster/sign to be placed at the West Room and building entrances and a short scripted greeting for North Desk staff. The poster will state the temporary pickup location and dates, required items to claim a reservation, that the printed pickup window still applies, and where to return items. The script will help staff check confirmations and library cards quickly and reassure borrowers about lookup procedures while noting the drill result as an operational caveat for staff only.
audience: Frontline staff (North Desk) and building visitors encountering the change
rationale: Clear signage and a short, consistent staff script will reduce confusion and speed throughput during the temporary move. The source gives exact facts needed for signage and a drill result that staff should be aware of when troubleshooting.
evidence: Temporary relocation: "existing West Room reservations will be collected at the North Desk in the same building"; dates: "between 12 and 16 May"; required items: "Bring the confirmation and a library card."; returns unaffected; and drill: "staff located nine of ten test records on the first lookup."
